en: Color postcard showing a small lakeside restaurant with a red roof on a tiny peninsula, trees, terraces with tables, and a long pier on calm water. In the distance are low resort buildings with red roofs and a forested shoreline under a bright blue sky. The back side has multilingual caption identifying the place as the Albatros Restaurant in Neptun, Romania, a Romanian stamp and Bucharest postmark, and blue handwritten message and address.
